QuestInfo.name: A Father's Love for His Daughter
QuestInfo.0: It seems #p206# in #m10001000# wants to express his feelings to his daughter.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p206##k in #b#m10001000##k asked me to deliver his homemade #t4031112# to #b#p506##k in #b#m10004000##k. It would be better if he delivered it himself, but... I can understand him being shy. \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 17 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I delivered #t4031112# to #p506# in #m10004000#. It seems #p506# felt #p206#'s sincerity after eating the dish.

0.0: Phew... Thanks to you, I was able to finish cooking for my daughter. It doesn't look like much, but fortunately, it tastes pretty good! So, about that... Could you perhaps deliver this #b#t4031112##k to my daughter?

yes.0: Thank you so much! I wanted to express my feelings to my daughter directly, but I felt a bit shy, and since I don't know how she feels yet, I thought it would be better to ask you. Please deliver this #b#t4031112##k to my daughter, #p506#, in #m10004000#.

no.0: I see... Even if you're a neighbor, I suppose asking for a favor like this was too much.

1.0: You're the one who helped me find my dad before. What brings you here today? What? You came to see me again because my dad asked you to?

item.0: You're the one who helped me find my dad before. What brings you here today? What? You say my dad sent something for me? But where is it...

npc.0: Please deliver this #b#t4031112##k to my daughter, #p506#, in #m10004000#.

lost.0: Oh dear... Are you saying you lost the dish I worked so hard to make! I trust you didn't eat it on the way. Luckily, I have a spare, so please hurry and deliver this to my daughter.
